description: Saki at the culture festival: all of NI_S6.BIN, NI_S6S.BIN, NI_S6W.BIN (612 strings; base 0x801E8000). Verified in DuckStation on forced festival days (tools/emu/force_festival.py, hidden emulator; docs/testing.md 'The culture festival'): her acceptance (S6S) and the tour of the Literature exhibit (S6W). Not seen: S6. Layout and flow in game-internals 6ab. The stage shows (Drama play, Band concert, Literature speech contest) are BUNKA_SD.EXN, still Japanese. Natural triggers, other years and moods checked only statically.
